To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a complete set of dynamic parameters of a KUKa LWR IV+ can be extracted from the linearly parametrized dynamic coefficients; (2) the extraction is performed through a nonlinear constrained optimization problem; (3) the optimization problem is solved through a genetic algorithm; (4) the genetic algorithm is able to converge to a global optimum; (5) the extracted parameters are used to simulate the dynamic behavior of the robot.
We propose an approach for extracting a complete set dynamic parameters of a robot arm, from a set of identified dynamic coefficients.
